facts.claim: Hyderabad City and its suburbs covered about 22 square miles and had a population of 351,962, giving a density of 16,134 people per square mile.
facts.quote: Hyderabad City with Suburbs, including Secunderabad, is the densest of all parts of His Highness the Nizam's Dominions, enrolling, within an area of nearly 22 square miles, 3,51,962 men, and having 16,134 men per square mile.
